# Workshop Facilitator Guide (3 hours)

Goal: align business outcomes with a safe, measurable LLM adoption plan.

## Pre-work (1-2 days before)
- Collect stakeholders and roles
- Share discovery questionnaire
- Identify 2-3 candidate use cases

## Agenda
1) Context + goals (15 min)
- Why now? success criteria

2) Use case deep dive (45 min)
- Inputs, outputs, constraints
- Data sensitivity and compliance

3) Architecture + security (40 min)
- Integration points
- SSO/RBAC + audit
- Data handling mode

4) Evaluation design (40 min)
- Scenarios + dataset
- Metrics + thresholds
- Baseline and gate

5) Pilot plan (30 min)
- Timeline and resources
- Decision gate

6) Exec readout (10 min)
- Summary and next steps

## Outputs
- Discovery brief (auto-generated)
- Eval framework draft
- Architecture decision
- Pilot success criteria

References
- Discovery wizard: `app/backend/scripts/discovery_wizard.py`
- Customer journey: `docs/blueprint/09_customer_journey.md`
